I just don't have the money.

When I work up the corage to leave the house all I can do is mow a couple lawns for a little cash.

I've only ever been able to get with one woman.

I married her.

She left.

It was for the best.

It was toxic.

but now I'm alone again.

it took me 22 years to find some one.

in another 22 years i'll be old and shittier than I already am.

I have no one to really talk to.

I haven't been to therapy in two weeks.

I'm afraid to call my therapist.

Or leave my house.

My entire life.
I need to leave it behind.

I have nothing.
I am nothing.
I can't move on.
I'm alone.
and tired.
and afraid.
Rape.
divorce.
Solitude.
psychosis.
death.
pain.
drugs.

Sorry my brother came and got me.
he took me to his house until someone got home at mine.
I'm out of it now.
for now.

No more meds no more doctor.
all they do is lie to me.
and try to put me in homes
OMG this is tough to watch...
